messages.subject: Invitation: Restructuring & insolvency update — lunchtime CPD, 6 May
messages.plaintextBody:
You are invited to our monthly CPD session: 'Directors' duties in the zone of insolvency — recent case law'. Thursday 6 May, 12:30–13:30, Training Room 2 (lunch provided) or by Teams. 1 CPD hour. Speakers from our Restructuring group and counsel from Eldon Chambers.

Register via the Learning portal. Spaces are limited.

Knowledge & Learning Team
